title: WWF In Your House
overview: 10 bodyslamming, mat-pounding, suplex-serving, ring-wrecking WWF Superstars, bringing on the killer-combo, combat carnage you crave! Experience a whole new level of hurt with hard-core super-pin finishing moves, plus every Superstar has his own personal fighting venue! With a houseful of Superstar soundbites, WWF In Your House is a 10-man wrecking crew... and they've got your address!
